title: anthropics/claude-plugins-community: a reviewed marketplace mirror for Claude extensions
friendlyTitle: Find community plugins for Claude Code and Cowork
summary: Anthropic’s community marketplace mirror collects third-party plugins for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, with submissions flowing through an internal review pipeline rather than direct pull requests. The repository was among the day’s fastest-moving AI projects and had about 1,300 stars when checked.
friendlySummary: This Anthropic repository lists community-made extensions for Claude tools and sends submissions through a review process.
whyItMatters: Claude Code users can add the repository as a marketplace and install task-specific plugins, while inspecting each plugin’s source and permissions before enabling it.
friendlyWhyItMatters: You can add new abilities to Claude, but check a plugin’s code and permissions before installing it.
